---
title: The Everything Brine
subtitle: The secret to juicy meat
---

This brine is more of a ratio than a recipe. You can use any unsalted liquid and meat. Brine the meat in the refrigerator for 24-48 hours and bring it to room temperature before cooking.

## The Ratio

50 g salt : 1 qt liquid

## Options

### Turkey Brine

3 qt apple juice, 1 qt cranberry juice, 200 g salt

Brine turkey in a 14 qt stock pot or 5 gallon bucket


### Lemon Chicken Brine

Use 1:1 ratio of water to lemon juice for a lemon brine

### Lime Pork Shoulder

3 c lime juice, 1 c water, 50 g salt
